directions.en: From Ikeja Bus Stop, move towards Computer Village. Continue straight until you reach First Bank. Allen Avenue runs beside it.
directions.yo: Láti Ikeja Bus Stop, lọ sí Computer Village. Tẹ̀síwájú títí dé First Bank. Allen Avenue wà lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ rẹ̀.

directions.en: From Allen Roundabout, head towards Opebi and cross the bridge near Spar.
directions.yo: Láti Allen Roundabout, lọ sí Opebi, kọjá afárá tó wà lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ Spar.
